trailhead.label: Vnà, by the PostBus stop, the board’s start

cautions: A steep descent of 385 m in 2 km: take it slowly with older dogs.
A short stretch on the Ramosch–Vnà road: lead short and keep to the side.
Cows may graze the meadows near the farm: lead short and go round the herd.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
